segments.text: When I worked on the COVID unit, you know who ran the COVID unit?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: There was no infectious disease nurse, there was no infectious disease doctor, there was no representative from the DOH, Department of Health that met with us to tell us what the protocol was.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It was two certified nurse assistants, two therapists, a physical therapist, occupational therapist, and a registered nurse.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That's who ran the COVID department at Oahu's biggest skilled nursing facility with the geriatric patients.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I never corresponded or met with Lieutenant Governor Josh Green.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: He never assessed the situation.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That's very weird.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Why wouldn't you assess this situation with this deadly virus?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We had no representative from the DOH come down and speak with us.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: There was no protocol other than move these patients to the COVID unit, isolate them for 14 days.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Some of them will make it, some of them won't.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Treatment was without.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They weren't given treatment because they had a positive PCR test.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: If a person had pneumonia or flu, there's this thing called off labeling.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They're no longer allowed to be treated for flu or pneumonia.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So they weren't given any antivirals and they weren't given any antibiotics, which would normally fight those things.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They were moved to a unit.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They were told there was no treatment for them.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Whoever made it, made it.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Whoever didn't, you know, didn't.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
